# Agentium

> Agentium makes Maria, a digital receptionist for businesses in Cyprus. Maria answers the business's phone 24/7 in Greek and English, and books, moves and cancels appointments straight into the business's calendar.

The site is in Greek (default, at /) and English (at /en/).

## What Maria does
- Answers every call, 24/7, including weekends and holidays.
- Answers several callers at once, so nobody hears busy.
- Books, moves and cancels appointments straight into the business's calendar.
- Knows the business: services, prices, opening hours and staff.
- Handles staff choice ("with Dr Eleni" or "anyone is fine").
- Recognises returning callers by their number and greets them by name.
- Reads the details back so nothing is booked wrong.
- Speaks Greek and English, and switches when the caller does.
- Spots urgent cases and offers the earliest free time.
- Takes messages and call-back requests, and emails the team when something needs a person.
- The business gets its own client page with every call's recording, transcript and a short summary.

## Plans (monthly, in euros, before VAT, no setup fee)
- Silver: 2 callers at once, up to 900 minutes a month, about 10 calls a day: EUR 239.
- Gold: 3 callers at once, up to 3,000 minutes a month, about 35 calls a day: EUR 489.
- Platinum: 5 callers at once, up to 7,500 minutes a month, about 85 calls a day: EUR 989.
- Diamond: 7 callers at once, up to 10,800 minutes a month, about 120 calls a day: EUR 1,449.
- Extra minutes: EUR 0.15 each.
